query: Nemotron model cards: tool calling / function calling support per model, agentic capabilities, structured output support, recommended system prompt / chat template, reasoning toggle for reasoning models (nano-omni-reasoning), and which Nemotron models support vision (Super-VL) vs text-only
response:
### Call Nano Omni with reasoning and JSON mode options

Source: https://github.com/nvidia-nemo/nemotron/blob/main/usage-cookbook/Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni/doc-intelligence-with-parse/doc_intelligence_cookbook.ipynb

`chat_template_kwargs={'enable_thinking': True}` toggles think-before-answer — the kwarg name is mandatory; `thinking` is silently ignored by the chat template, which leaves reasoning ON by default. For direct transcription calls (reasoning="off") a `/no_think` system message is ALSO injected as belt-and-suspenders. Sampling best-practices: thinking mode uses top_p=0.95; instruct mode uses top_k=1. json_mode sets `"response_format": {"type": "json_object"}`. Request fields: model, messages, max_tokens, temperature, stream, chat_template_kwargs, top_p/top_k.

--------------------------------

### Toggle reasoning on/off with chat_template_kwargs

Source: https://github.com/nvidia-nemo/nemotron/blob/main/usage-cookbook/Nemotron-3.5-Lightning/sglang_cookbook.ipynb

Reasoning is on (default); response includes `reasoning_content` when enabled. Reasoning off via extra_body `{"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": False, "force_nonempty_content": True}}`. Sampling in cookbook: temperature=1.0, top_p=0.95, max_tokens=4096.

--------------------------------

### Nemotron 3.5 Super VL model card (spec table)

Source: https://github.com/nvidia-nemo/nemotron/blob/main/src/nemotron/recipes/super35/README.md

120B total / 12B active hybrid Mamba-Transformer LatentMoE VLM; C-RADIO encoder + VL projector; temporal video embedder (image/video stack, no audio); one recursively shared MTP head; context up to 1M tokens; checkpoints Base-BF16/BF16/NVFP4; HF ids nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B-{Base-BF16,BF16,NVFP4}.

--------------------------------

### Reasoning mode with /think

Source: https://github.com/nvidia-nemo/nemotron/blob/main/usage-cookbook/Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2/transformers_cookbook.ipynb

Nemotron Nano supports two reasoning modes: ON (default) and OFF. Toggle via /think or /no_think in the system message.

model 'nvidia/nvidia-nemotron-nano-12b-v2-vl'; reasoning_mode toggles /think vs /no_think system message; content parts image_url/video_url/text; streaming; reasoning_content delta.
